# Send4 MCP server

> Setup guides and the tool list for the hosted Send4 MCP server at https://mcp.send4.ai/mcp. Connect an AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and others) to a Send4 workspace, then read and, where the workspace allows it, change its flows, campaigns, conversations, leads and calendar.

This repository contains documentation and client configuration only. It does **not** contain the MCP server implementation: Send4 hosts the server, and you connect to it with its address. Sign-in is OAuth in the browser, as yourself.

## Getting started

- [README](https://github.com/send4ai/send4-mcp-server/blob/main/README.md): what the server does, one-click setup, how it works, data and security.
- [Supported assistants](https://github.com/send4ai/send4-mcp-server/tree/main/docs/connect): a setup guide for each assistant.
- [Help centre](https://send4.ai/support/ai-assistant-tools/): the same topics on send4.ai.

## Reference

- [Tools](https://github.com/send4ai/send4-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/tools.md): every tool, grouped by the permission that allows it.
- [Permissions](https://github.com/send4ai/send4-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/permissions.md): the workspace switches, the sign-in choices and who can use what.
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/send4ai/send4-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)
- [Example prompts](https://github.com/send4ai/send4-mcp-server/blob/main/examples/prompts.md)

## Client configuration

- [.mcp.json](https://github.com/send4ai/send4-mcp-server/blob/main/.mcp.json): `{"mcpServers": {"send4": {"type": "http", "url": "https://mcp.send4.ai/mcp"}}}`
- [gemini-extension.json](https://github.com/send4ai/send4-mcp-server/blob/main/gemini-extension.json): `gemini extensions install https://github.com/send4ai/send4-mcp-server`

## Security

- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/send4ai/send4-mcp-server/blob/main/SECURITY.md): report a vulnerability privately.
